note: Marion County Conservation park on the county's 300-acre Roberts Creek Lake, next to Lake Red Rock; county-run, not Army Corps. East campground is in two blocks, north and south of the entrance road, with a campground host. --Claude
summary: County pages confirm 55 full hookups, $30, $4 fee, weekend and holiday minimums, 14 days; added 6-month window, 10-night Nationals minimum, season dates; lakeview lead to not waterfront.
flags: WATERFRONT LEAD (lakeview -> not waterfront, unsure so going down; I changed nothing): only the south block's tip (map sites 37-41, about 41.4232,-93.0446) comes near water, about 75-80 m from the south shore, across a slope of brush and trees and scattered mown grass. The north block is in meadow surrounded by woods, roughly 300 m+ from the nearest water. I can't tell from above whether a camper at 37-41 actually sees the water. Campsite photos on mycountyparks would settle it; I didn't read them.
PIN: stored 41.4262,-93.04314 is at the road junction by registration, between the blocks. North block about 100-250 m, south block about 240 m. Good.
SPLIT: no. North and south blocks of East are about 300 m apart off one entrance. West is a separate campground and already its own entry.
UNREAD: I read one campsite page (East-02: 'back-in 53 foot long concrete pad'), not all 55, and took rules as common. I didn't find a posted closure.
